# What Do I Update?

> A free app that tells ordinary people, in plain English, when something they own (phone, computer, browser, router, app) has a security flaw hackers are actively using, and exactly where to tap to update it. No account, no tracking; device lists stay on the phone.

Alerts come from CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (flaws used in real attacks), refreshed hourly. News items lead with the maker's or a government's own notice; items not yet confirmed by the company or an agency are labeled Unconfirmed. We never send download links.

Data updated Nov 23, 2026.

## Current alerts

- [Update your Synology drive](https://whatdoiupdate.com/alerts/update-your-synology-drive-cve-2024-10441.html): Do now: hackers are using this flaw. Affects Home storage drive (Synology, QNAP). Added Nov 18, 2026.
- [Update Chrome and restart it](https://whatdoiupdate.com/alerts/update-chrome-and-restart-it-cve-2026-125350.html): Do now: hackers are using this flaw. Affects Chromebook, Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera or Vivaldi. Added Nov 10, 2026.
- [Update Outlook](https://whatdoiupdate.com/alerts/update-outlook-cve-2026-124194.html): Do now: hackers are using this flaw. Affects Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook (desktop app). Added Nov 10, 2026.
- [Make sure your Apple devices are up to date](https://whatdoiupdate.com/alerts/make-sure-your-apple-devices-are-up-to-date-cve-2024-27834.html): Update this week: hackers are using this flaw. Affects iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Mac, Safari. Added Nov 4, 2026.
- [Run Windows Update and restart](https://whatdoiupdate.com/alerts/run-windows-update-and-restart-cve-2026-96951.html): Update this week: hackers are using this flaw. Affects Windows PC. Added Oct 13, 2026.
